messages:
Arjun: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating remediation items for GPU capacity / autoscale. Need clear owners, timelines, and a couple fixes we can ship quickly.
SRE-bot: Incident PM-2026-03 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-03-gpu-autoscale — follow-ups live in the tracker.
Maria: I can own the quota request and vendor comms. Will open the ticket today.
Sam: I’ll take scheduler tuning and can prototype config changes in staging.
Kelly: I’ll own headroom dashboards + alerting. Will add a weekly trend job to detect regressions.
Nate: Noted recurring pattern: most pressure aligns with nightly batch churn 02:00-05:00 UTC. We should consider a small burst reserve during that window.
Arjun: Owners noted: Maria -> quota & vendor (OWN-412), Sam -> scheduler tuning (OWN-413), Kelly -> headroom dashboards & alerts (OWN-414), Nate -> pattern analysis + runbook update (OWN-415). Please add your OWN numbers to the tracker.
Maria: Filing quota ticket now — linking infra-quotas and procurement. Ticket #7890. ETA: initial request by Fri EOD.
Sam: Quick sketch for scheduler changes — will test canary:```
scheduler:
  binpacking_threshold: 0.75
  preemption_backoff_ms: 200
  node_headroom_fraction: 0.12
```Plan: canary on 10% of nodes Mon, expand Wed if stable.
Kelly: Dashboard plan: add node-level p95 GPU utilization panel, set alert if p95 > 75% for 10m, plus a drift job that reports weekly 90/95 percentiles. Will create dashboard PR by Tue.
Nate: Adding to runbook: note for SRE on-call to check batch windows and pause noncritical batch jobs when headroom < 10%. Also propose an automated throttle patch for schedulers.
Arjun: Timeline summary: quota request submitted by Fri (Maria), scheduler canary Mon->Wed (Sam), dashboard + alerts live by next Fri (Kelly), runbook + automated throttle spec by next retro (Nate).
Maria: Pinged infra-quotas team, they requested expected peak and burst duration. I’ll attach the utilization samples and the PM link.
Sam: If canary shows no regressions, we’ll roll to 50% next Friday. Will post results in tracker.
Kelly: Dashboard PR opened: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/PR-452. Added initial panels and alert rules.
SRE-bot: Reminder: set OWN-413 and OWN-414 due dates in the action tracker or they get auto-escalated in 7d.
Arjun: Small checklist before we close follow-ups: 1) quota ticket with samples (Maria), 2) scheduler canary + perf shard (Sam), 3) alerts + dashboards (Kelly), 4) runbook update + throttle proposal (Nate). If anyone needs help, ping me.
Maria: Done — ticket #7890 updated with samples and timeline. Assigning to infra-quotas.
Sam: Will post canary logs to the thread once staging run completes.
Kelly: Alert created and tested in staging. Notified #oncall. :thumbsup:
Nate: I’ll draft the throttle spec tonight and attach to OWN-415.
Arjun: Thanks all — we’ll review progress in the weekly incident follow-up on Thursday. Mark items as blocked/complete in the tracker so we have clean visibility. Closing notes: avoid changing quantization or model variants as a workaround unless approved by ML infra — want infra fixes first.
Maria: ACK.
Sam: ACK.
Kelly: ACK.
Nate: ACK.
